name: Kenderes (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged at the centre with the town arms of Kenderes (a white shield with crossed tools, with a helm, a crane crest and blue and grey mantling) above the name KENDERES in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kenderes arms with helm, crest and mantling
